display.title: Sampson 2021 · sdLDL-C estimate
display.summary: Lipid subfraction estimate; not equivalent to direct measurement. In direct mode enter LDL-C; in panel mode enter total cholesterol and HDL-C. Independent clinical review has not been performed.
display.description: Lipid subfraction estimate; not equivalent to direct measurement. In direct mode enter LDL-C; in panel mode enter total cholesterol and HDL-C. Independent clinical review has not been performed.

opts.panel: Calculate LDL-C from the lipid panel

display.formula: sdLDL-C = LDL-C − (1.43 × LDL-C − 0.14 × ln(TG) × LDL-C − 8.99), in mg/dL. In panel mode, LDL-C = TC/0.948 − HDL-C/0.971 − (TG/8.56 + TG × (TC − HDL-C)/2140 − TG²/16100) − 9.44. TC, HDL-C and TG in mg/dL. ln denotes the natural logarithm.
display.methodVersion: Sampson 2021; optional LDL-C calculation by Sampson–NIH 2020
display.limits: Lipid subfraction estimate; not equivalent to direct measurement. In direct mode enter LDL-C; in panel mode enter total cholesterol and HDL-C. Independent clinical review has not been performed.

resultLabels.Índice derivado em adultos de uma popula: Index derived in adults from a population in northern Italy. It does not diagnose steatosis in an individual or assess fibrosis. Clinical applicability and the translation of this implementation await independent review.
resultLabels.A equação foi desenvolvida para estimar: The equation was developed to estimate population means in Japanese adults aged 20 to 59 years. A single sample does not determine an individual’s salt intake; urinary excretion also does not necessarily equal intake. Do not use it for individual clinical decisions. Clinical and translation review is pending.
resultLabels.Estimativa de subfração lipídica, não do: Estimate of a lipid subfraction, not a laboratory measurement. Triglycerides up to 800 mg/dL follow the use limit of the Sampson–NIH equation; other limits are technical. It is not a diagnosis and does not replace clinical assessment. Clinical and translation review is pending.
resultLabels.TFG estimada não é medição direta nem di: Estimated GFR is not a direct measurement or a stand-alone diagnosis. Confirm laboratory standardization, the population and changes over time. Independent clinical review of the implementation is pending.

terms.tgCap: mg/dL · up to 800 with the Sampson–NIH method
terms.estimatePanel: Calculate LDL-C from the lipid panel
terms.meanCrCys: mean of creatinine and cystatin C estimates
terms.egfrIntro: Select the equation according to age and available markers. Data are processed on this server and are not sent to NIDDK.
terms.fliIntro: Equation published by Bedogni and colleagues in 2006. The calculation uses data entered here and runs on the ELUCENIA server. Field ranges are technical input limits, not clinically validated ranges. Do not enter patient identifiers.
terms.tanakaIntro: Tanaka method (2002). The result is a NaCl equivalent and estimates a population mean, not an individual measurement of intake. Enter only data without patient identifiers. Field limits are technical; only the age range reflects the study population.
terms.sdldlIntro: Sampson 2021 equation. Use measured LDL-C or estimate LDL-C from the lipid panel with Sampson–NIH 2020. Calculations run in ELUCENIA; do not enter patient identifiers.
terms.egfrLimits: Estimated GFR is neither a direct measurement nor a diagnosis on its own. Confirm laboratory standardization, population and changes over time. Independent clinical review of this implementation is pending.
terms.fliLimits: Index derived in adults from a population in northern Italy. It does not diagnose steatosis in an individual or assess fibrosis. Clinical applicability and the translation of this implementation await independent review.
terms.tanakaLimits: The equation was developed to estimate population means in Japanese adults aged 20–59 years. A spot sample does not determine individual salt intake; urinary excretion does not necessarily equal intake either. Do not use it for individual clinical decisions. Clinical and translation reviews are pending.
terms.sdldlLimits: Estimated lipid subfraction, not a laboratory assay. Triglycerides are limited to 800 mg/dL by the applicability limit of the Sampson–NIH equation; other limits are technical. It is not a diagnosis and does not replace clinical assessment. Clinical and translation reviews are pending.

shared.fleischner: Before calculating: reference for incidental pulmonary nodules. The recommendations do not apply to people under 35, lung cancer screening, immunosuppression or known primary cancer.
